root.label: Trump administration announces new Iran sanctions

events.label: Trump administration announces new Iran sanctions

slots.name: sanctions status
slots.sentence: Well, Donald Trump has put new sanctions on Iran and on countries that do business with Iran.

slots.name: Tehran flight decline
slots.sentence: Flights to and from Tehran’s Imam Khomeini international airport have fallen 42 percent, according to aviation monitor FlightRadar24, with routes to Georgia, Oman and Azerbaijan halted entirely and flights to Dubai suspended since September 23.

slots.name: Turkiye route decline
slots.sentence: Flights to China have held steady, while the busiest route, to Turkiye, has fallen by only 19 percent, even as individual airlines have shifted service on and off the route.

slots.name: effective date
slots.sentence: The US ban, which took effect on September 23 and targets any company doing business with Iranian airlines, has sharply cut Iran’s international air links.

events.label: US sanctions Iran rail and auto sectors

slots.name: domestic auto market share
slots.sentence: Treasury said the two companies represent more than 90% of Iran’s domestic auto market.

slots.name: sanctions status
slots.sentence: The Treasury Department sanctioned Iranian auto and rail industries Thursday, the latest salvo in its economic campaign against the Islamic Republic.

slots.name: sanctions date
slots.sentence: WASHINGTON, Oct 1 (Reuters) - The Trump administration imposed sanctions on Iran's rail and auto sectors and their foreign suppliers, the Treasury Department said on Thursday, widening its wartime economic campaign to isolate Tehran.

slots.name: sanctioned entities
slots.sentence: The sanctions designate Iran Khodro Company, or IKCO, and SAIPA Iranian Automobile Manufacturing Company, or SAIPA.

slots.name: campaign name
slots.sentence: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Thursday his department’s financial warfare campaign against Iran — which he dubbed Operation Economic Outcast — has “severely diminished” the regime’s “ability to fund its war machine and inflict terror” via its own military, as well as through regional proxies.
